Context since this Task was written (2026-11-14), to check before building from scratch/migrations.md on jack-heart/migrations:
- Since #110 (v0.3.2) each launcher schema version has its own file, `~/.etude/launcher-<schema>.db`, and the launcher never migrates; this computer has `launcher.db` and `launcher-17.db`. The old branch predates that.
- EXP-66 (in progress, unmerged, branch jack/exp-66-name-the-job-files-entry-point-training_runs) changes the schema again: cohorts removed, `Machine.state` derived, and the SSH controller renamed `server` (`etude server run`). Its design says older files are refused. Build on, or coordinate with, that branch rather than main alone.
- Manabot (PR #500) is pinned to EXP-66 commit 9e8fec1 and has not migrated its local launcher database; records from earlier versions are stranded in the older files.
Re-plan the Task description against this before implementing; say what of the 2026-10 design still holds.
